notes.title: The Quintessential Quintuplets OMOIDE VR ~Itsuki~ 6 Degrees of Freedom Update Av
notes.content:
Thank you for playing The Quintessential Quintuplets OMOIDE VR ~Itsuki~.

The 6 Degrees of Freedom Update for The Quintessential Quintuplets OMOIDE VR ~Itsuki~ we mentioned in our previous announcement has been released!

Experience the game in a whole new way! With this update, you can adjust your field of view by moving your headset. By changing your point of view, you can feel closer to Itsuki than ever before!

Give this all-new way to experience the game a try!

Also, we have a special announcement prepared for January, so please look forward to it!

We hope you continue to enjoy The Quintessential Quintuplets OMOIDE VR.

notes.title: The Quintessential Quintuplets OMOIDE VR ~Itsuki~ 6oF Update Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Thank you for playing The Quintessential Quintuplets OMOIDE VR ~Itsuki~.

We'll be bringing 6 Degrees of Freedom to OMOIDE VR ~Itsuki~ in a big update coming soon!

Enjoy your VR experience even more than ever! You'll be able to adjust your in-game field of view simply by moving your head with your VR headset on. See things from new angles and feel closer to Itsuki than ever before!

The update is scheduled for mid-December. We hope you look forward to it!

Dev Team
